fields.label: Description
fields.value:
Brochure printed in black ink on tan paper. Includes a photograph of people posing on and around a railcar, as well as a statement about the Communicative Arts Academy (CAA), program description, and lists of objectives, services, benefactors, contributions, and affiliations. 

After co-founding Watts Towers Arts Center, Judson Powell created the CAA in Compton in 1969. CAA operated for six years, during which it offered over 70 dfferent classes, provided space for art exhibitions and  theater performances, and served as a venue for a range of events from a funeral to a chopper show. Deindustrialization and a weakened tax base due to white flight led to financial instability and the folding of CAA in 1975.
